explanation: Faithfully encodes erdosproblems.com/1209's first question ('for sufficiently fast-growing a, does one n with all n + a_k prime imply infinitely many?') as the negation of the existence of a growth bound f, and proves it. The counterexample is the page's: all a_k prime (so n = 0 works) with n + a_n composite for every n ≥ 1.
